source: Yin et al., Scientific Data 12, 1722 (2025), Table 3
licenseScope: Factual published aggregate class counts; this repository does not reproduce clips or metadata subject to unknown media reuse terms.
measurement: 30-second clips labelled by 5 researchers; 15 cameras in 6 locations; no Chilean beaches
caution: Site aggregate counts contain NO video pixels, wave/wind inputs or individual event history; cannot train a visual model or predict La Boca surfing quality. Categories plunging/spilling/surging are not campanas, rideability or wave-face height.
